verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד שָׂ֭מַחְתִּי בְּאֹמְרִ֣ים לִ֑י נֵלֵֽךְ׃ בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה
verses.transliteration: šîr ham·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ lə·ḏā·wiḏ śā·maḥ·tî bə·’ō·mə·rîm lî nê·lêḵ bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: A song of ascents Of David I was glad when they said to me Let us go to the house of the LORD
Our feet are standing . . . in your gates O Jerusalem

verses.original: יְרוּשָׁלִַ֥ם הַבְּנוּיָ֑ה כְּ֝עִ֗יר שֶׁחֻבְּרָה־ לָּ֥הּ יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.transliteration: yə·rū·šā·lim hab·bə·nū·yāh kə·‘îr še·ḥub·bə·rāh- lāh yaḥ·dāw
verses.literal: Jerusalem is built up as a city united together

verses.original: שֶׁשָּׁ֨ם שְׁבָטִ֡ים עָל֪וּ שִׁבְטֵי־ יָ֭הּ עֵד֣וּת לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְ֝הֹד֗וֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šeš·šām šə·ḇā·ṭîm ‘ā·lū šiḇ·ṭê- yāh ‘ê·ḏūṯ lə·yiś·rā·’êl lə·hō·ḏō·wṯ lə·šêm Yah·weh
verses.literal: where the tribes go up the tribes of the LORD as a testimony for Israel to give thanks to the name of the LORD

verses.original: כִּ֤י שָׁ֨מָּה׀ כִסְא֣וֹת לְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט יָשְׁב֣וּ כִּ֝סְא֗וֹת לְבֵ֣ית דָּוִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: kî šām·māh ḵis·’ō·wṯ lə·miš·pāṭ yā·šə·ḇū kis·’ō·wṯ lə·ḇêṯ dā·wîḏ
verses.literal: For there the thrones of judgment stand the thrones of the house of David
Pray for the peace of Jerusalem May those who love you prosper
May there be peace within your walls [and] prosperity inside your fortresses

verses.original: לְ֭מַעַן אַחַ֣י וְרֵעָ֑י אֲדַבְּרָה־ נָּ֖א שָׁל֣וֹם בָּֽךְ׃
verses.literal: For the sake of my brothers and friends I will say . . . Peace [be] within you

verses.original: לְ֭מַעַן בֵּית־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ אֲבַקְשָׁ֖ה ט֣וֹב לָֽךְ׃
verses.literal: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God I will seek your prosperity
